reviewedChange: Now resolves and authorizes an explicit workspaceId from the URL before any overview data is read, and replace-redirects bare entry to a canonical /app/project?workspaceId=... Previously the page took no parameters at all and getProjectOverviewData resolved the ambient cookie internally, so a shared or bookmarked link rendered whatever Project the cookie happened to hold. getProjectOverviewData is owned by another lane and still takes no argument, so this page additionally compares the returned payload's own workspaceId against the authorized Project and renders a neutral Project unavailable state rather than showing Project A's members and budget under a URL that names B. New rendered state added (Project unavailable). This surface has screenshotCoverage none and no approvedBaselineReference, so no baseline exists to recapture.
